note: Apache httpd + shibd (RDM-Shibboleth-SP-main-private, CentOS base) in front of web; replaces fakecas with --auth shibboleth. Published on 127.0.0.1 (GRDM_PORT_SHIBBOLETH_SP, default 8082) over plain HTTP: the browser must reach /Shibboleth.sso/Login and POST the SAML Response to /Shibboleth.sso/SAML2/POST, and the acceptance guard allows only http://127.0.0.1 (SPEC-04 section 3.4); TLS adds nothing on loopback, so handlerSSL=false and the session cookie is HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax without Secure (SP_COOKIE_PROPS). The SP entityID points at this service, the trusted IdP is the bundled test_idp (IDP_* values; SPEC-04 S5). Access control: the RequestMap of shibboleth2.xml requires eduPersonAffiliation to contain SP_REQUIRED_AFFILIATION (`member`, the GakuNin common value); a user without it gets the SP 403 error page and no GRDM session (S5 rejection). Config files come from templates/idp/sp-*.tmpl rendered into runtime/config/shibboleth_sp/ (follow-up F-1), the key pair from `secrets init` (follow-up F-2), see templates/idp/README.md. Whether the real RDM flow goes web -> cas-overlay -> SP or web -> SP directly must be confirmed against RDM-Shibboleth-SP-dev2027 at M3 (TODO(M3) in test_s5_shibboleth.py). Root and the listed capabilities stay as recorded in manifest/hardening.json until M4.
